product: Moonshot AI Kimi K3 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
tagline: Model Serving now supports Kimi K3 as a Databricks hosted model.
what_it_does: Model Serving now supports Kimi K3 as a Databricks hosted model. This 2.8 trillion parameter mixture of experts (MoE) model has native vision capabilities, supports a 1 million token context window, and is designed for long horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning. You can access this model using Foundation Model APIs.
why_it_matters: For production workloads, Databricks recommends priority pay per token, also referred to as priority mode, for latency sensitive workloads that need more consistent performance under load.
